study_identification_part.si_4_title: Resting-State Changes in Aging and Parkinson ' s Disease Are Shaped by Underlying Neurotransmission: A Normative Modeling Study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single dataset (UK Biobank) used for rs-fMRI healthy controls and PD subgroup.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We included 25,917 adult participants from the UK Biobank not diagnosed with psychiatric, cognitive, or neurological disorders (Table S1) with known effects on brain structure and function as a control cohort. We also identi /uniFB01 ed a group of 58 participants from the UK Biobank who were diagnosed with idiopathic PD (ICD-10, G20) before their imaging session."

answer.UK Biobank: Healthy controls used for normative modeling; PD subgroup used for deviation analyses; age- and sex-matched HC subcohort used for PD comparisons.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative modeling based on HC data; PD comparisons referenced to age- and sex-matched HCs.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Normative modeling of colocalizations between brain function and neurotransmitter systems was based on the data of HCs. Regional differences in brain measures in patients with PD were calculated with respect to an age- and sex-matched subcohort of HCs."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: HC count for normative modeling reported as combined n.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "We included 25,917 adult participants from the UK Biobank... as a control cohort... Normative modeling of colocalizations between brain function and neurotransmitter systems was based on the data of HCs."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age is reported for combined HC sample in Table 1 (mean ± SD).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female percent computed from Table 1 counts; male percent reported.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "Combined, n = 25,917 | Females, n = 14,000 | Males, n = 11,917"; "Sex, Male | 11,917 (46%)"
